m: एकी—भाव m. the becoming one, coalition, Vedāntas.; RPrāt. &c.
a: एकीभावः — 1 Combination, association. --2 Common nature or property.

m: एकी-भाव-स्तोत्र n. N. of a Stotra.
एकी—˚भाविन् mfn. relating to coalition or blending (of vowels), RPrāt.
एकी—√ भू to become one, be blended or combined, ŚBr.; MBh.; RPrāt. &c.
a: एकीभू — {c1c} P. To become one, blend, combine, be mingled.

v: na॰ eka + aBUtatadBAve cvi--kf--anuprayogaH lyuw । anekaDAmyAdeH rASikaraRenaM ekatApAdane । karmmaRi kta । ekIkfta taTApAdite DAnyAdO tri॰ ekI + BU--GaY । ekIBAva anekaDAnyAdeH rASitAprApaRarUpe vyApAre pu॰ । karttari kta । ekIBUta ekatvaprApte anekaDAnyAdirASyAdO । kf--lyap । ekIkftya taTApAdanaM kftvetTarTe avya॰ BUlyap । ekIBUya ekatvaM prApyetyarTe avya॰ ।
m: एकी—करण n. the act of making one, uniting, combination Comm. on TPrāt.
एकी—√ कृ to unite, combine, associate, R.; RāmatUp.
a: एकीकृ — {c8c} U. 1 To collect. --2 To unite, join together, combine.

s: tri, (ekasmin tizWatIti । eka + Ca .) ekapakzaH । sahAyaH । sahaBAvI । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: tri॰ eka + BavArTe tasyedamityarTe vA Ca । 1 ekapakzaBave sahAye, 2 ekasambanDini ca ।
m: एकीय mfn. belonging to or proceeding from or resting upon one, Gṛhyās.
belonging to the same party, a partisan, associate, companion.
a: एकीय — a. Belonging to, or proceeding from, one. --यः A partisan, an associate.
